name: SAQ-2015
description: A shared task/dataset for evaluating systems that answer schema-agnostic queries over semantic web / knowledge graph data.
reputation: Established shared task within the semantic web community with moderate adoption for KG query-answering research.
notes: Focuses on schema-agnostic query answering over knowledge graphs; evaluation is geared toward semantic-web/SPARQL systems rather than general LLMs and may be relatively small/domain-specific.
